hypothesis: The causal options order-flow imbalance x near-ATM implied-vol interaction level of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset interaction spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward signed log-return mean of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-150 floor.
extends: EVAL-148 (cross-asset atm_iv -> signed return mean) + EVAL-149 (cross-asset order-flow imbalance -> signed return mean) + EVAL-71 (surface atm_iv verbatim) + EVAL-62 (imbalance verbatim) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment) + EVAL-101 (forward signed log-return mean target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference); distinct cell: interaction spillover -> forward signed return mean

cross_section.spillover_signal: signal_k = imbalance_z[OTHER](k) * atm_iv_z[OTHER](k)  (interaction of the other asset's order-flow imbalance z and near-ATM IV z)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar interaction of the OTHER underlying's z-scored options order-flow imbalance and near-ATM implied-vol level (e62.build_states tox_signal='imbalance' x e71.build_surface_bars atm_iv — SURFACE bar, not the term bar), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid, forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward signed log-return mean = sum(log(close_i/close_{i-1})) over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-101
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_interaction_z_k, own_signed_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset order-flow imbalance x atm_iv interaction -> more positive forward signed return on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
